statements.select:
SELECT 'S' AS MODE ,AUTH_ID , AUTH_NM , #company_cd# AS COMPANY_CD , ISNULL(AUTH_DIV,'N') AS AUTH_DIV , ISNULL(AUTH_TEAM,'N') AS AUTH_TEAM , ISNULL(AUTH_PERS_1,'N') AS AUTH_PERS_1 , ISNULL(AUTH_PERS_2,'N') AS AUTH_PERS_2 , AUTH_DESCRIPT , ISNULL(USE_YN,'N') AS USE_YN , REG_DT , REG_USR , MOD_DT , MOD_USR FROM T_AUTHORITY WHERE 1=1
AND AUTH_ID LIKE '%' + #searchAuthId# + '%'
AND AUTH_NM LIKE '%' + #searchAuthNm# + '%'

SELECT USR.COMPANY_CD ,AUTH.AUTH_ID AS AUTH_ID , AUTH.USER_CD AS USER_CD , USR.USER_NM AS USER_NM , DEP.DEPT_NM AS DEPT_NM , USR.EMAIL AS EMAIL , AUTH.AUTH_DESCRIPT AS DESCRIPT , AUTH.USE_YN AS USER_YN , AUTH.REG_DT , AUTH.REG_USR , AUTH.MOD_DT , AUTH.MOD_USR FROM T_AUTH_USER AUTH ,T_USER USR ,T_DEPARTMENT DEP WHERE 1=1 AND AUTH.USER_CD = USR.USER_CD AND USR.DEPT_CD = DEP.DEPT_CD
AND AUTH_ID = #selectAuthId#
AND USR.COMPANY_CD = #company_cd#

SELECT CASE WHEN ISNULL(AUTH.AUTH_ID,'') = '' THEN 'I' ELSE 'U' END AS MODE ,#company_cd# AS COMPANY_CD ,MENU.MENU_ID AS MENU_ID , MENU.MENU_NM AS MENU_NM , MENU.MENU_LEVEL AS MENU_LEVEL , MENU.UP_MENU_ID AS UP_MENU_ID , CASE WHEN MENU_LEVEL = 3 THEN ISNULL(AUTH.USE_SCOPE,'R') ELSE '' END AS USE_SCOPE , ISNULL(AUTH.DEPT_YN,'N') AS DEPT_YN , CASE WHEN MENU_LEVEL = 3 THEN ISNULL(AUTH.ODEPT_SCOPE,'SELF') ELSE '' END AS ODEPT_SCOPE , CASE WHEN MENU_LEVEL = 3 THEN ISNULL(AUTH.IDEPT_SCOPE,'N') ELSE '' END AS IDEPT_SCOPE , AUTH.AUTH_DESCRIPT AS DESCRIPT , ISNULL(AUTH.USE_YN,'N') AS USE_YN , ISNULL(AUTH.AUTH_ID,#selectAuthId#) AS AUTH_ID , AUTH.REG_DT , AUTH.REG_USR , AUTH.MOD_DT , AUTH.MOD_USR ,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_MENU WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' AND UP_MENU_ID = MENU.MENU_ID) AS CHILD_CNT FROM (SELECT * FROM T_MENU WHERE USE_YN = 'Y') MENU LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM T_AUTH_MENU WHERE 1=1 AND AUTH_ID = #selectAuthId# ) AUTH ON MENU.MENU_ID = AUTH.MENU_ID WHERE 1=1
AND MENU.UP_MENU_ID = #upmenuId#
AND MENU.MENU_ID = #menuId#

SELECT USR.USER_CD AS USER_CD , USR.USER_NM AS USER_NM , DEP.DEPT_NM AS DEPT_NM , USR.EMAIL AS EMAIL , USR.REG_DT , USR.REG_USR , USR.MOD_DT , USR.MOD_USR FROM T_USER USR LEFT OUTER JOIN T_DEPARTMENT DEP ON USR.DEPT_CD = DEP.DEPT_CD WHERE USR.USE_YN = 'Y'
AND USR.USER_NM LIKE '%' + #UserNm# + '%'
AND USR.DEPT_CD = #DeptGroup#
AND (DEP.UP_DEPT_CD = #BizGroup# OR USR.DEPT_CD = #BizGroup#) AND USR.DEPT_CD IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY USER_NM
statements.insert: INSERT INTO T_AUTH_USER ( AUTH_ID , USER_CD , AUTH_DESCRIPT , USE_YN , REG_DT , REG_USR , MOD_DT , MOD_USR ) VALUES ( #auth_id# ,#auth_user_cd# , '' , 'Y' , GETDATE() , #user_cd# , GETDATE() , #user_cd# )
statements.delete: DELETE FROM T_AUTH_USER WHERE AUTH_ID = #auth_id# AND USER_CD = #auth_user_cd#
statements.insert: INSERT INTO T_AUTHORITY ( AUTH_ID , AUTH_NM , AUTH_DIV , AUTH_TEAM , AUTH_PERS_1 , AUTH_PERS_2 , AUTH_DESCRIPT , USE_YN , REG_DT , REG_USR , MOD_DT , MOD_USR ) VALUES ( #auth_id# ,#auth_nm# , #auth_div# , #auth_team# , #auth_pers_1# , #auth_pers_2# , #auth_descript# , #use_yn# , GETDATE() , #user_cd# , GETDATE() , #user_cd# )
statements.update: UPDATE T_AUTHORITY SET AUTH_NM = #auth_nm# ,AUTH_DIV = #auth_div# ,AUTH_TEAM = #auth_team# ,AUTH_PERS_1 = #auth_pers_1# ,AUTH_PERS_2 = #auth_pers_2# ,AUTH_DESCRIPT = #auth_descript# ,USE_YN = #use_yn# ,MOD_DT = GETDATE() ,MOD_USR = #user_cd# WHERE 1=1 AND AUTH_ID = #auth_id#
statements.insert: INSERT INTO T_AUTH_MENU ( AUTH_ID , MENU_ID , USE_SCOPE , DEPT_YN , ODEPT_SCOPE , IDEPT_SCOPE , AUTH_DESCRIPT , USE_YN , REG_DT , REG_USR , MOD_DT , MOD_USR ) VALUES ( #auth_id# ,#menu_id# , #use_scope# , #dept_yn# , #odept_scope# , #idept_scope# , #auth_descript# , #use_yn# , GETDATE() , #user_cd# , GETDATE() , #user_cd# )
statements.update: UPDATE T_AUTH_MENU SET USE_SCOPE = #use_scope# ,DEPT_YN = #dept_yn# ,ODEPT_SCOPE = #odept_scope# ,IDEPT_SCOPE = #idept_scope# ,USE_YN = #use_yn# ,MOD_DT = GETDATE() ,MOD_USR = #user_cd# WHERE 1=1 AND AUTH_ID = #auth_id# AND MENU_ID = #menu_id#
statements.delete: DELETE FROM T_AUTH_MENU WHERE AUTH_ID = #auth_id# AND MENU_ID = #menu_id#
